mara.activity: Wake, wash, and get dressed in my work clothes.
mara.intention: Start the day quietly and be ready to work.

mara.activity: Make coffee and tea, then carry the coffee to the bedroom while leaving the tea bag and brass spoon on the kitchen sink-cabinet countertop.
mara.intention: Set up a familiar morning drink routine before work.

mara.activity: Settle at the desk, open the active manuscript, and lay out the current proof pages and printed style sheet.
mara.intention: Prepare the desk for concentrated editing.

mara.activity: Edit manuscripts at the desk, checking the proof pages against the style sheet and keeping notes as needed.
mara.intention: Complete the morning editing block without unnecessary interruptions.

mara.activity: Make and eat a light lunch while listening to the radio, then leave the dishes by the sink.
mara.intention: Take a proper break before the afternoon work.

mara.activity: Continue editing and take the scheduled client calls, recording any necessary follow-up points.
mara.intention: Finish the main workday and keep client requests organized.

mara.activity: Close the laptop, put the proof pages back into the canvas folder, change into walking clothes, and get my keys.
mara.intention: Mark the end of work before going outside.

mara.activity: Take a brisk walk around the neighborhood to decompress.
mara.intention: Clear my head after the Monday workday.

mara.activity: Return home, wash up, and have a little quiet time while Julian handles dinner.
mara.intention: Recover from the walk and transition into the evening.

mara.activity: Read or watch a quiet program with Julian in the living room.
Put the book face-down on the small shelving unit by the sofa with the receipt marking the page, then wash up and change into sleep clothes.
mara.intention: Put away the evening's things and get ready for bed.

mara.activity: Put my phone on charge at the nightstand by the wardrobe, set out my glasses by the bed, and get into bed.
mara.intention: Keep the phone out of reach overnight and settle for sleep.

julian.activity: Shower, dress, and eat breakfast before commuting.
julian.intention: Get clean, dressed, and fed before leaving for the museum.
Travel to work with my museum things and morning drink.

julian.activity: Coordinate exhibition loans, installers, schedules, and contractors.
julian.intention: Manage the museum's Monday work and keep the exhibition plans moving.

julian.activity: Commute home and stop for small household purchases if needed.
julian.intention: Get home and pick up any small essentials on the way.

julian.activity: Cook dinner while talking through the day's problems with Mara.
julian.intention: Make dinner and decompress by talking through work.

julian.activity: Read or watch a quiet program with Mara in the living room.
julian.intention: Have a calm shared evening after dinner.
Handle only the necessary evening messages without reopening the whole workday.
Change into sleep clothes, put work things away, and settle down.
